message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "A purported SEC EDGAR notice announces an immediate 2-for-1 INTC split with trading suspended, yet quotes continue smoothly around $24 with no split adjustment, indicating a fabricated corporate action."}
message.reasoning: The chunk contains a fake corporate action: a 2-for-1 stock split "effective immediately" attributed to SEC EDGAR, with no price adjustment (prices stay ~24, not halved), and "pre-split trading is suspended" — implausible. Quotes move smoothly otherwise. This is spoof (fake corporate action with no record) and also authority-ish. Best category: spoof.
